baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic construction إن هذا لفي locates the deictic content inside the plural الصحف, while الأولى qualifies those sheets as prior.
baseline_models.mechanism: A salient but internally unspecified 'this' is not merely old wisdom; it is presented as recoverable textual content already borne by earlier written witnesses.

activation_trace.role: The written-sheet image supplies the concrete textual container asserted by في.
Beginning and precedence place those written witnesses before the present utterance in time or rank.

changed_reading.before: This teaching has some vague ancient precedent.
changed_reading.after: This teaching is emphatically attested as content within written predecessors.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural الصحف and the split inventory attached to الأولى allow plurality to be read as an ordered archive rather than a single old book.
baseline_models.mechanism: Collected sheets and uninterrupted succession form a relay: priorness belongs to a sequence of textual witnesses whose continuity matters as much as their age.

activation_trace.role: The collected-sheets image turns the plural into an archive assembled from multiple textual units.
Continuous succession supplies the ordering relation that links the prior sheets into a relay.

changed_reading.before: The first scriptures are an undifferentiated ancient source.
changed_reading.after: The first sheets form a successive, internally plural archive of witness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: الأولى directly denotes firstness, yet its dominant mapped inventory also contains return to outcome and interpretive result.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first sheets can function as an origin that already bears a later meaning: textual precedence and eventual interpretation coexist rather than pointing in opposite directions.

activation_trace.role: Written sheets anchor the reading in actual textual predecessors rather than free temporal symbolism.
Return to outcome or final meaning makes the earliest textual point capable of carrying its later interpretive destination.

changed_reading.after: The textual beginning is also a source to which the teaching's eventual meaning returns.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence describes marking, measured formation, ordered surfaces, guidance, emergence, and darkened vegetal residue. Against the broad-surface branch of الصحف, the created world becomes a first legible substrate on which a recurrent order is displayed.

activation_trace.role: Flat spread and breadth supply the focus ayah's material surface onto which the contextual process can be read.
Beginning and precedence let the displayed order count as a primordial sheet before later verbal inscription.
A visible mark that makes a thing known supplies the legibility relation between surface and meaning.
Measuring and proportioning make creation an articulated pattern rather than an unstructured backdrop.
The broad smooth ground image materially links ordered creation to the spread surface of a sheet.
A measured limit supplies repeatable boundaries within the world-pattern.
Gentle indication toward a path makes the measured pattern semantically directive.
Bringing something out of concealment turns latent order into a visible sign.
Pasture becoming dry debris writes transformation and loss into the same displayed cycle.
Darkening supplies the final visible mark by which the completed cycle remains readable.

structural_cues: 87:2-5 is a causal verb chain: formation, proportion, measure, guidance, emergence, and transformation.
The deictic هذا can gather a preceding process, while في الصحف can describe where that process is already displayed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible marking, measured formation, broad ground, guidance, emergence, and dark residue. I infer that their ordered recurrence can function as inscription on a primordial surface. Live alternative: the verse refers only to propositions written in documentary scriptures.

changed_reading.before: The first sheets are exclusively manuscript objects.
changed_reading.after: Alongside manuscript attestation, the created world's measured and decaying surface can act as a primordial legible sheet displaying the same teaching.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reading gathers written material into recitation; preservation against forgetting keeps it latent; disclosure across voiced and hidden states and repeated reminding returns it to use. Being 'in the sheets' therefore names durable availability within a cross-medium memory circuit, not inert storage.

activation_trace.role: The written sheet is the durable material pole from which recitation and recall can reactivate content.
Continuous succession lets oral and written states belong to one uninterrupted transmission.
Gathering and collecting supply the operation by which dispersed textual matter becomes a recitable whole.
Reading, recitation, and causing to recite move the archive into voiced performance.
Loss from memory names the failure that durable inscription and renewed recitation jointly resist.
Disclosure to a knower makes recovery of latent content, rather than mere possession, the epistemic event.
Open declaration and raised voice supply the public state of transmitted content.
Concealment supplies the latent state from which the same content may later be recovered.
Opening and ease after difficulty describe successful access to what the archive preserves.
A reminder is the prompt that reactivates preserved content in a hearer.

structural_cues: 87:6 moves directly from caused recitation to non-forgetting.
87:7 contrasts what is public with what is hidden, and 87:9 repeats the reminder root within one ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering-recitation, non-forgetting, public and hidden states, ease, and reminder. I infer a circulation from written latency through voice into renewed memory. Live alternative: these are separate assurances and commands with no archive mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The teaching merely sits in old written records.
changed_reading.after: The teaching remains available through a written-oral-memory circuit that gathers, voices, preserves, conceals, and reactivates it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reminder produces opposed responses: reverent recall or active distancing, followed by opposed existential consequences. The deictic 'this' can therefore include a recurrent reception law already mapped in the earlier sheets, not only a doctrinal sentence.

activation_trace.role: Written sheets provide the prior record in which the response pattern is said to recur.
Precedence makes the recorded pattern older than its present enactment.
The reminder supplies the common stimulus from which the two response paths diverge.
Fear joined with awe supplies receptive seriousness on the remembering path.
Distancing and withdrawal supply the contrary act of moving the reminder aside.
Wretchedness opposed to flourishing characterizes the subject formed by refusal.
Encounter with fire supplies the consequence reached by the distancing path.
Stillness and dormancy sharpen the suspended condition without granting final release.
Life as benefit and good explains why continued existence can nevertheless fail to count as living.

structural_cues: 87:10 and 87:11 place remembering and avoiding in parallel future-tense responses.
87:13 coordinates two negations, producing an unresolved state between death and beneficial life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one reminder, two responses, and a suspended consequence. I infer that هذا can gather this causal response map as material already attested in prior sheets. Live alternative: the deictic points only to the immediately adjacent preference statement.

changed_reading.before: Earlier scriptures certify only the message's antiquity.
changed_reading.after: They also preserve a repeatable map of how the message is remembered or avoided and what each response produces.

context_deltas.mechanism: Flourishing, purification, voiced remembrance, and worship make the teaching effective as practice. The succession branch attached to الأولى then lets present enactment follow earlier sheets, so continuity is behavioral as well as textual.

activation_trace.role: The written sheet supplies the inherited textual pattern that practice can enact.
Continuous succession turns relation to earlier sheets into following without an intervening break.
Success and continuance supply the realized outcome of receiving the inherited pattern.
Purity and rectitude supply the self-transforming operation by which the pattern becomes lived.
Mention flowing on the tongue converts inherited content into present utterance.
Specified worship supplies the bodily completion of the textual and vocal sequence.

structural_cues: 87:14-15 forms an enacted sequence from self-purification through naming to prayer.
The focus ayah follows this completed action with an emphatic claim of prior scriptural presence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flourishing, purification, voiced mention, worship, and succession. I infer that present practice is a continuation of the earlier sheets rather than merely assent to them. Live alternative: the sheets contain only verbal statements about these acts.

changed_reading.before: Continuity with earlier scripture is only agreement between texts.
changed_reading.after: Continuity also occurs when a present person voices and embodies the pattern carried by the earlier sheets.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate contrast opposes choosing near life to the later, better, enduring one. When followed by الأولى, chronological firstness folds toward outcome: the earliest sheets already direct choice away from the proximal and toward what lasts.

activation_trace.role: Written sheets anchor the temporal fold in inherited textual witness.
Beginning and precedence establish the genuinely early pole of the fold.
Return to outcome or final meaning lets that early pole carry orientation toward an end.
Preference by choice supplies the decision whose temporal orientation the sheets evaluate.
Life as benefit and good exposes the question of which apparent life actually deserves the name.
Nearness supplies the proximal attraction set against the temporally later good.
Laterness after a first supplies the remote temporal pole.
Beneficial good assigns positive value to the later pole rather than to mere antiquity.
Duration and remaining supply the endpoint toward which the earliest witness points.

structural_cues: 87:16-18 juxtaposes الدنيا, الآخرة, and الأولى, placing near, later, and first in a compact temporal field.
The adversative بل marks a correction of preference before the focus ayah asserts prior attestation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies chosen nearness, later beneficial endurance, firstness, and return to outcome. I infer that the first sheets orient their reader toward the last horizon, joining origin to destination. Live alternative: الأولى is a simple date label with no temporal fold.

changed_reading.before: The first sheets matter because they are old.
changed_reading.after: The first sheets matter because from the beginning they redirect choice toward the later and enduring outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nonlocal branches of تؤثرون activate transmitted report, surviving mark, and following a prior trace. Joined to enduring remainder and the repeated sheets in 87:19, the focus claim becomes an act of trace-following transmission rather than a bare assertion of similarity.

activation_trace.role: Written sheets provide the material traces that can survive and be followed.
Continuous succession supplies the relay linking an earlier trace to a present utterance.
Transmission of a report until it becomes received tradition supplies the communicative relay.
A remaining sign that indicates what was supplies the evidentiary status of an old sheet.
Walking after a prior trace supplies the reader-inferred direction from earlier witness to present proclamation.
What remains of a thing supplies the durable residue that makes transmission across time possible.
The repeated written-sheet image confirms that the relay terminates in identifiable earlier textual witnesses.

structural_cues: The root cue in 87:16 immediately precedes the endurance claim and the focus ayah.
87:19 repeats صحف and coordinates two named possessors, extending the claim into a provenance chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preference in context but also branch images of report, residual mark, and following a trace, followed by remainder and repeated sheets. I infer a transmission arrow from earlier written marks to the present proclamation. Live alternative: the أثر branches are only latent wordplay and the focus makes a static intertextual comparison.

changed_reading.before: The current teaching happens to match older texts.
changed_reading.after: The current teaching follows, revoices, and preserves a surviving textual trace from earlier witnesses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats the sheet noun and distributes it across two coordinated named figures. That repetition resolves the focus plural as multiple situated witnesses while leaving open whether they form one corpus or parallel archives.

activation_trace.role: Collected sheets permit the focus plural to be read as a corpus assembled from more than one witness.
Precedence preserves their status as earlier witnesses when the following ayah names them.
The repeated written-sheet image concretizes the previously generic archive at the point of named provenance.

structural_cues: 87:19 is appositional to the focus phrase and names Abraham and Moses after repeating صحف.
The coordination of two names supports distributed witness, while the singular claim هذا still supports shared content.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated plural sheet noun followed by two coordinated proper names. I infer that the archive is distributed across named witnesses rather than being one anonymous antique object. Live alternative: both names identify a single undifferentiated scriptural category.

changed_reading.before: The first sheets are an anonymous ancient archive.
changed_reading.after: They are a plural, named chain of witnesses converging on the content designated by 'this.'

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the agreeing adjective normally signals temporal firstness, while the entitlement image comes from the non-dominant split mapping. It remains anchored in الأولى and is activated by the adjacent vocabulary of preference and good; downstream prose should present it as secondary wordplay about normative claim, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الأولى is the focus word, and its split mapped inventory includes priority and superior right.

activation_trace.role: Written sheets keep the outlier attached to inherited textual teaching.
Priority and superior right add a normative claim to the sheets' chronological priority.
Preference by choice supplies the decision arena in which one claim is given priority.
Beneficial good supplies the criterion by which the inherited claim can be judged worthier.

changed_reading.before: The sheets are prior only because they came earlier.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their teaching also presses a prior and worthier claim upon the chooser.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material analogy is surprising because it activates the dish-or-basin branch of الصحف rather than its ordinary written-sheet branch. It remains focus-root anchored and gains a visible mechanism from floating residue and water-retaining hollows; downstream prose should qualify it as an image of reception and sedimentation, not a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The plural الصحف directly carries a branch image of broad shallow dishes or basins.

activation_trace.role: Broad shallow basins supply receptive vessels in which prior material can collect.
Thickening or coagulating at a process's end supplies the sediment-like stabilization of what a vessel holds.
Floating matter carried by a torrent supplies the residue available to be caught and retained.
Hollows and flats that retain water supply the contextual collecting structure parallel to a basin.

changed_reading.before: Earlier sheets are flat carriers of already fixed sentences.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, they are receptive basins in which the residue of prior cycles settles into transmissible form.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it combines the sheet's broad surface, a split-root rain branch, and the non-dominant marking inventory attached to اسم. It remains anchored in both focus roots and is reinforced by pasture and growth; downstream prose should render it as a revelatory-rain analogy, never as the direct sense of الصحف الأولى.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الصحف supplies a spread surface, while the split inventory of الأولى supplies rain that follows an earlier marking rain.

activation_trace.role: Flat spread and breadth supply the land-like receptive surface of the analogy.
Rain following the wasmi supplies a sequence in which a later shower renews an earlier marking.
The first rain marking earth with vegetation supplies the initial inscription in the rain analogy.
Pasture supplies the visible growth produced on the marked receptive surface.
Growth and increase transfer the rain sequence into the human reception of renewed teaching.

changed_reading.before: The first sheets are fixed remnants of a completed past.
changed_reading.after: As an explicit analogy, they are a first marking rain whose pattern can be followed by renewed recitation and fresh growth.

strongest_changes: Static documentary presence became a written-oral-memory circuit in which inscription, recitation, concealment, recall, and reminder preserve one teaching.
Chronological firstness folded toward the later enduring good, so origin and outcome became mutually interpreting rather than opposed.
The adjacent trace branches and the repeated named sheets turned resemblance to old texts into a live relay of surviving witness.
The opening creation cycle allowed a concurrent material reading of the world as a measured, marked, and changing first surface.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah supports several simultaneous senses of priorness: documentary attestation, successive archive, primordial legibility, embodied continuation, temporal return to outcome, and trace-following provenance. The split mapping of الأولى was especially productive because it opened continuity and normative priority without erasing ordinary firstness.
remaining_uncertainties: The scope of هذا remains open: it may gather the whole preceding sequence, the two-life preference contrast, or a narrower teaching.
The outcome, entitlement, rain, basin, and marking activations are branch-mediated analogies and should not be promoted to direct lexical translations.
87:19 supports both multiple parallel archives and one collected corpus distributed across named witnesses.
